title: Chop, Chop, Chad!
lines: Chad has to chop it up with Dad.
His chum Meg picks up a pan.
Then Chad tips in the yam chips.
Such a rich dish! Such chums!

questions.listenFor: A big yam. It is stated in the story - if they guess, have them find the line with yam in it.
Dad does. Chad chops with Dad, Meg picks up the pan, Dad puts it on the heat - one job in three parts.

questions.ask: Do you think the dish was good? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story, like "yes, it says it was rich."
